description: The terms for using New Moon: Lunar Calendar, including the one time remove adverts purchase, the guidance disclaimer and Apple's required provisions.
summaryText: New Moon is a free app with one optional purchase that removes its banner advert. The lunar day guidance is drawn from tradition and offered for reflection and planning. It is not medical, psychological or financial advice, and you should not treat it as any of those.

sections.content:
You must be at least 16 if you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, and at least 13 anywhere else. If you are under the age of majority where you live, you may use the app only with the involvement of a parent or guardian, who accepts these terms on your behalf.

The app shows advertising and asks for permission to track. Neither is appropriate for a young child, and the App Store age rating reflects that.

sections.title: The guidance is not advice
sections.content:
This is the most important clause on the page.

Activity guidance draws on traditional lunar-day interpretations and is offered for reflection and planning, not as medical, psychological, or financial advice.

Astronomical figures, meaning the moon phase, the illumination percentage and the lunar day, are calculated from an established model and we intend them to be accurate. The recommendations attached to each lunar day are a different thing: they come from traditional interpretation, not from science, and we make no claim that following them produces any particular outcome.

Do not use the app to decide anything about your health, your medication, your treatment, your money or your investments. Ask a qualified professional about those. Nothing in the app is a diagnosis, a prognosis or a recommendation to buy or sell anything.

sections.title: The in-app purchase
sections.content:
The app is free. It offers one non-consumable in-app purchase which permanently removes the banner advert from the app.

  • It is a one time payment. There is no subscription, no recurring charge, no auto renewal and no free trial.
  • The price is set per territory on the App Store and is shown to you before you confirm.
  • Payment is taken by Apple through your Apple ID.
  • It restores on other devices signed in to the same Apple ID, through Restore Purchases in Settings or on the purchase screen.
  • Refunds are handled by Apple, not by us. Request one through Apple's support site. We cannot issue a refund for an App Store purchase.

Unless you buy the removal described above, the app shows one banner advert above the tab bar, on each of its four tabs, served by a third party advertising network. We do not control which specific adverts appear. What the advertising involves for your data is set out in the privacy policy.

Adverts, and any website or App Store page an advert sends you to, are the advertising network's and the advertiser's. We do not select, review, endorse or vouch for them, and we are not responsible for their content, their accuracy or anything you buy from them. Complaints about a specific advert are best sent to us anyway, because we can report it to the network.

If you send us a message through the contact form, or rate a recommendation, you allow us to use that submission to answer you, to fix problems and, in the case of ratings, to produce anonymous aggregate statistics shown to other users. Ratings are not attached to your identity.
